alex: quick alert - embedding short queries (<32 tokens) in eu-west1 returning intermittent 503s since ~02:08 UTC. p95 stable, p99 error spike. Likely regressed quant path from yesterdays build.

marie: any customer impact?

alex: limited but visible; a few support tickets. No schema changes.

alex: I've prepared a revert image redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Posting deploy request for expedited approval. Option: canary 5% for 3m then ramp, or skip canary with unanimous approve.

deploy-bot: Deploy request 6420012345 created by alex. Approvers required: eng-leads (marie) + ops-oncall (tim-oncall). Preflight: integration-tests PASS, smoke: WARNING.

tim-oncall: oncall ack. I can approve if we do 5% canary 3m and I monitor traces.

marie: approve for eng assuming ops watches. /approve 6420012345

tim-oncall: approving now. /approve 6420012345

deploy-bot: Approvals recorded: marie, tim-oncall. Starting canary 5% for embeddings-eu -> redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/6420012345

alex: running drain and image set: kubectl set image deploy/embeddings-eu embeddings=redwood/embeddings:v2.3.2-hotfix -n prod-eu

deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 180s. Errors in new pods 0, latency stable.

tim-oncall: canary green. Ramp to 25% for 4m then full if stable.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 100%. Post-deploy healthchecks PASS, e2e-smoke PASS.

alex: drained prefix cache and warmed. No regressions observed in 12m.

marie: please add release note and support blurb.

alex: Adding release note: "Embeddings: reverted quant kernel to v2.3.2 to resolve 503s on short embeddings in eu-west1. Canary ramp and cache drain performed."

tim-oncall: filing incident ticket for RCA. Closing thread when notes posted. :white_check_mark:
